label: 🖼️ IMAGEN / CONCEPTO, TODAVÍA HAY QUE CONSTRUIRLO — terrain v2, procedural 0 CU

file_layout.albedo: ter_<name>_albedo.webp — RGB sRGB, no alpha (v1 ter_<name>_albedo_height.webp is retired)
file_layout.height: ter_<name>_height.png — lossless 8-bit grayscale PNG, linear 0..1, 1024x1024 (same UV tile as the 2048 maps; bilinear upsample is fine for height-blend). Fine relief detail lives in the 2048 normal map.
file_layout.normal: ter_<name>_normal.webp — tangent space, OpenGL +Y (Godot default), baked from height with real relief

tiling: all maps periodic; seam_edge_diff ~= interior_neighbour_diff for every material; previews ter_<name>_tile2x2_preview.jpg
height_blend: weight_i = max(0, height_i + splat_i - max_j(height_j + splat_j) + 0.15); contrast 0.1-0.2. Mud lowest, cobble domes / slabs / grass tops highest.

cobblestone.blend: domed cobbles ~12-18 cm (13 per 2 m tile), deep dark joints with mud in places; dirt/mud height-blend into the joints first

dirt_path.blend: low/medium height; grass edges bleed in by height+noise mask; mud fills its low areas

grass_lush.use: meadows, outside the walls, riverbanks top
grass_lush.blend: tallest material: wins height-blends against short grass/dirt; pair with grass card scatter; v2: low-frequency macro patches (yellow-green / dark-green, ~1 per tile)

grass_short.blend: height-blend over dirt_path: bare soil patches (low alpha) give way first; v2: low-frequency macro patches (yellow-green / dark-green, ~1 per tile)

mud.use: wet low ground, near millrace, gate approach, livestock pens
mud.blend: lowest height: always sits under others; puddles = low roughness where height<0.3; v2: roughness 0.08-0.40 (wet), AO smoothed (no speckles)

plaza_flagstones.use: central plaza, around fountain/gazebo, castle forecourt
plaza_flagstones.blend: irregular worn slabs of mixed size (recursive split + noise warp, no grid), chipped edges, moss in some joints; dirt blends into joints

riverbank_pebbles.use: river edges, under the bridge, millrace banks
riverbank_pebbles.blend: rounded pebbles high; sand low; wet darkening zones lower roughness - bias wet zone toward water side

wall_base_gravel.use: 1-2 m strip at the foot of the city wall, towers, gatehouse
wall_base_gravel.blend: loose angular gravel in 3 overlapping layers on dirt (not a mosaic); dirt shows between; weeds at wall line

cobblestone_b.use: variant b of cobblestone (different seed/joint pattern); noise-mix with variant a to break the repeat
cobblestone_b.blend: domed cobbles ~12-18 cm (13 per 2 m tile), deep dark joints with mud in places; dirt/mud height-blend into the joints first

cobble_mix: Mix ter_cobblestone (a) and ter_cobblestone_b with low-frequency world-space noise n (period ~6-10 m) through a sharp height-blend so whole cobbles switch (no ghosting): d=(h_a+1.6*(1-n))-(h_b+1.6*n); w_a=clamp(d/0.08+0.5). Same 2 m tile and scale. Preview: ter_cobblestone_ab_mix_preview_CONCEPTO_.jpg (8x8 m).
